title: Toolkit Quickstart Visuals: Batching & KV Cache + Quantization UI Assets
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and deliver a set of onboarding/quickstart UX assets and product screenshots for the Optimize toolkit focused on batching, KV cache recommendations, and the quantization UI. Assets will be used in the Console quickstart, product docs, and the in-product onboarding overlay. Goal: reduce first-time configuration friction and clearly communicate the trade-offs (latency vs cost vs quality) when enabling batching, caching, and quantization presets.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma frames for: (1) 'Batching & Latency' quickstart card, (2) 'KV Cache' visual explainer with request flow and cache hit/miss states, (3) 'Quantization Presets' UI showing quality vs cost slider and recommended presets.
Three finalized screenshot variants (desktop) exported at production resolution for Console & docs: default, advanced, and fallback states.
Annotated asset pack (PNG + SVG + copy sheet) for docs team with microcopy, tooltip copy, and localization keys.
Accessible color contrast and component states documented; keyboard/tab interactions and screen-reader hints described.
Design signoff from PM (Lina Grover) and engineering readiness review with ENG-3891 noted dependencies.
A/B variant for the quickstart card copy tested in a small usability session (n=6) with summarized results attached.
All assets uploaded to Figma project 'Optimize Toolkit / Quickstart 2026' and linked in the ticket.
tasks: Audit current Optimize toolkit docs and existing screenshots in Console
Create low-fidelity sketches showing onboarding flow and primary decision points
Design hi-fi mockups for the three primary components: batching, KV cache, quantization
Define microcopy for tooltips, recommendation rationale, and confirmation modals
Build a screenshot checklist for engineering to enable consistent states for capture
Export assets and prepare annotated pack for docs and localization
Collect PM and ENG feedback, iterate on visuals, and finalize handoff

2026-02-28 - Lina Grover (PM): Suggest adding a small explainer modal for quantization that includes quick benchmarks (CPU cost reduction %, sample latency) — PM will provide numbers from Research.
